title: Boom Wash – Multi-Purpose Foaming Cleaning Powder (300ml)
description:
Powerful Foaming Action for Everyday Household Cleaning!

Keep your home clean and fresh with Boom Wash Multi-Purpose Cleaning Powder, a fast-foaming cleaning solution designed to help remove grease, food residue, soap buildup, and stubborn dirt from household drains and washable surfaces.

Formulated with alkaline cleaning agents, surfactants, and enzyme-based cleaning ingredients as described by the supplier, Boom Wash helps break down unwanted buildup and supports regular household cleaning.

Key Features & Benefits

Fast-Foaming Formula: Produces an active cleaning foam when mixed with water.

Grease & Dirt Removal: Helps break down grease, fats, oils, soap residue, food waste, and stubborn dirt.

Multi-Purpose Cleaning: Suitable for various household drains and cleaning areas.

Drain Maintenance: Helps reduce buildup that may contribute to blocked drainage pipes.

Odour Control: Helps remove unpleasant odours caused by accumulated waste.

Easy to Use: Simple application with water and a recommended 30-minute soaking time.

Suitable Applications

Kitchen sinks and drainage pipes

Bathroom washbasins and sinks

Toilet drains

Floor drains

Washing machine drainage areas

Bathtub and shower drains

Other compatible household drainage pipes

How to Use

Take an appropriate amount of Boom Wash cleaning powder.

Carefully pour the powder into the drain or area requiring cleaning.

Add an appropriate amount of water to activate the foaming action.

Allow the product to work for approximately 30 minutes.

Flush thoroughly with water. For accessible surfaces, gently brush away any remaining dirt if appropriate.

Important: Water is required to activate the cleaning foam. Follow the instructions and recommended quantities on the product packaging.

Product Specifications

Product Name: Boom Wash

Product Type: Multi-Purpose Foaming Cleaning Powder

Form: Powder

Declared Ingredients: Alkaline solvent, surfactants, and enzyme-based cleaning ingredients

Pack Size: 300ml (as supplied)

Application: Household drains, sinks, basins, and compatible cleaning areas

Safety Information

Keep out of reach of children and pets.

Avoid contact with eyes and skin.

Wear suitable protective gloves when handling.

Do not mix with bleach, acids, or other cleaning chemicals.

Use only on surfaces and drainage materials confirmed compatible by the manufacturer.

Follow all safety instructions provided on the product packaging.

Why Choose Boom Wash?

Make everyday cleaning easier with Boom Wash. Its fast-foaming formula is designed to tackle household grease, residue, and dirt in drains, sinks, and other compatible areas.

Boom Wash – Powerful Foam. Easier Cleaning. Fresher Spaces.
